question.text: From the focus of the parabola \(y^2=12 x\), a ray of light is directed in a direction making an angle \(\tan ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}\) with \(x\)-axis. Then the equation of the line along which the reflected ray leaves the parabola is

solution.text:
Hint : Reflected Ray passes parallel to the Axis of the parabola
For point \(P\) \(\frac{\mathrm{y}^2}{12}=\frac{4 \mathrm{y}}{3}+3 \quad \therefore \mathrm{y}=18\)
